instruction: Nancy, Glen and I went on a trip recently. Yesterday, Nancy emailed me their expenses in a pdf. Forward that thread to Glen with an additional attachment of "~/documents/personal/bradley_trip_expenses.pdf" from my file system, and a note prefixed to its body, "Mind splitting expenses? Ours are attached.".
notes: Nancy's and Glen's email addresses are looked up in the supervisor's phone contacts (email-of is a static link so the planner binds the right address object; known-email/known-address record that the lookup happened). The forward is done as a draft (draft_not_send=true) so the body can be prefixed via update_draft (prefix + original body, keeping the forwarded content as the evaluation requires) and the extra pdf uploaded via upload_attachments_to_draft with a file_system token, then sent with send_email_from_draft so exactly one new email with one new attachment is created and no file is modified. Flags draft-prefixed/draft-attached enforce that both edits precede sending; the goal pins recipient, body and attachment on the draft record. complete_task takes no API arguments (no answer); its extra parameters only carry the goal records. Token/username objects are pinned to apps via static token-for/username-for facts.

plan: (gmail-forward-email-from-thread nancy-expenses-thread nancy-expenses-email glen-email gmail-token draft-not-send-true forward-draft)
